inheritedFindings.description: The public docs route did not await the session before SSR. Under the reproduced timing precondition, a server loading button hydrates as a client anonymous sign-in link.
inheritedFindings.attribution: Actual B/current footer, useUser/session-query, React Query and Radix execute in an isolated Chromium SSR/hydrateRoot probe. Both unseeded variants reproduce the mismatch; both preseeded positive controls have no recoverable errors. The B footer has no localization hook.
inheritedFindings.attributionLimit: The probe deliberately resolves the anonymous session before footer hydration. It is not a full baseline-app browser reproduction and does not independently identify the exact scheduler of the parent desktop failure.
inheritedFindings.correction: The docs route awaits the existing sessionQueryOptions through ensureQueryData. null remains a public anonymous session; no redirect, footer/loading style, auth/cache redesign, or new auth mechanism.
inheritedFindings.unitScope: 4 tests use the actual docs beforeLoad, real router, QueryClient, session query, footer/hooks and Radix; auth/server I/O and generated content data are mocked. Anonymous and signed-in SSR/serialized client initial renders agree, delayed sessions block route completion, and the unseeded negative control produces different branches. These are SSR/cache tests, not DOM hydration tests.
inheritedFindings.appBrowserAcceptance: Parent-owned post-fix desktop/mobile browser run is separate; do not infer it from these SSR tests.
